What was more, at Podar they had struck a happy balance between play school activities and studies and Seya simply loved going to school.

It is not exactly an easy job to handle and train 15 - 20 ...3 year olds single handedly at the same time.  But Madam Sapna Shah did an excellent job and the kids simply loved her and were extremely  attached to her . This bond between teacher and students works wonders and I was delighted to find that Seya had improved in  discipline , obedience and verbal skills too !!!

Even a slight deviation  from expected standards of discipline is usually enough to send parents into a panic mode and we easily tend to  over react to such situations. That is exactly the time the competency and expertise of HM maam- Mrs Sneha Thakur comes into action . She posesses not only the technical skills to handle such situations , but the very fact that she is  a mother herself , has given her a very  practical insight into the situation  and she ends up  counselling not only  the child but also calming  down the over reacting and panic sticken parent  too !!! 😂😂😂 .

To sum up then , I am really grateful to the staff and teachers in Podar for doing a really commendable job in shaping our kids . But as parents if u also share my passion for nurturing well behaved , disciplined and intelligent kids and are always on  the lookout for new techniques and methods for their betterment I would like to end this post with a tip . There is a great video on you tube ...

"SLEEP DEEP
RISE SUCCESFUL "

which deals with programing a child's sub conscious mind in sleep with Maa Sarswati 's  meditation and affirmations....
Watch it if u are totally geared up , passionate  and focused for the betterment of ur child.
